dependencies.version: PowerShell 7 and GitHub CLI JSON output

bootstrap.freshEnvironmentProof: Run both phases on a disposable Windows x64 runner with an empty npm cache and no design/node_modules directory. A cache hit may accelerate the run, but npm ci must remain the supported cache-miss path.
bootstrap.cacheMissPolicy: Do not rely on a pre-populated node_modules directory or globally installed project dependencies.

policy.codeSigning: Prohibited. The workflow clears inherited signing inputs, disables forceCodeSigning only in a temporary build copy, and verifies Setup.exe is NotSigned.
policy.releaseChannel: Stable release only: draft=false and isPrerelease=false after tests and artifact checks pass.
policy.pages: The Pages workflow is present and self-hosted; it remains unverified until a matching runner deploys the site and the live URL is checked.
